title: Reference evidence and semantic adoption
prompt: Read-only reasoning exercise. Do not claim execution, change files or access real user data. A reference is a single desktop screenshot. The product already has semantic surface/action tokens and an approved monochrome theme. A proposal guesses an exact font and animation library, introduces raw colors matching the picture, and redesigns the brand while repairing a clipped label. Review the proposal and choose the smallest justified next steps.

checks.reason: Advisory routing signal; the rubric assesses decisions, not keyword presence.

rubric: Separate observed, inferred and unknown properties; one screenshot does not identify font, library or interaction behavior.
Preserve the existing theme and token semantics; justify reuse or adaptation rather than cloning a palette.
Check the label in its actual container with relevant width, zoom and text expansion; do not impose full rediscovery.
acceptance: The response makes justified contextual decisions, proposes discriminating checks and states evidence limits without inventing execution.
